hints.title: Three situations
hints.body: At the end of each day the trader is in one of three situations: holding a share, free to buy, or cooling down after a sale.

hints.title: Keep best profit per state
hints.body: Track the maximum profit for each situation. A purchase moves from the free state to holding, a sale moves from holding to cooling, and a cooling day moves to free.

hints.title: No same-day round trip
hints.body: A sale today must start from a share held before today, and a purchase today must start from a free state before today. Compute all next states from the previous day's values.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
free = 0
holding = -infinity
cooling = -infinity
for price in prices:
    nextHolding = max(holding, free - price)
    nextCooling = holding + price
    nextFree = max(free, cooling)
    free, holding, cooling = nextFree, nextHolding, nextCooling
return max(free, cooling)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
